# Week 6 — Saturday final call (2026-10-17)

Games lock Sunday 9:30am ET (Jaguars/London) through Monday night. Thursday's SEA@DEN game is already final. This is the last call before lineups lock — be decisive.

## Source and freshness

Primary: committed fixture `weekly-report-week-6.json` (FantasyPros consensus + ESPN injuries), generated **2026-10-13T17:11:02Z** — after Week 5's Monday-night finale and before Week 6's first kickoff, so no stale carryover. Overlay: live `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` Week 6 practice report, re-scored through an `AvailabilityModel` freshly fit on 2023-2025 (24,031 player-weeks). By Saturday morning essentially every team has filed a Friday practice report, so this overlay is now close to final.

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | If-he-plays | P(play) | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | vs ARI (Sun 4:05pm ET) | 21.42 | 22.13 | 96.8% | Healthy |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs TEN (Sun 1:00pm ET) | 20.19 | 21.29 | 94.9% | Healthy |
| RB | Bucky Irving | vs PIT (Sun 1:00pm ET) | 14.24 | 15.02 | 94.9% | Healthy |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | @DEN — **final** (Thu, SEA 14-17) | 18.65 | 20.91 | 89.2%* | Questionable (played) |
| WR | Drake London | vs CHI (Sun 1:00pm ET) | 17.40 | 18.02 | 96.5% | Healthy |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | vs NO (Sun 1:00pm ET) | 12.77 | 13.14 | 97.2% | Healthy — forced in, LaPorta on bye |
| FLEX | Cam Skattebo | vs NO (Sun 1:00pm ET) | 11.74 | 12.35 | 95.1% | Healthy — forced in, J. Williams on bye |
| FLEX | Jalen Coker | @PHI (Sun 1:00pm ET) | 11.13 | 11.52 | 96.6% | **Cleared** — forced in, Higgins on bye |
| K | Dominic Zvada | vs NO (Sun 1:00pm ET) | 8.14 | 8.27 | 98.4% | Healthy |
| DEF | Jaguars D/ST | vs HOU (Sun **9:30am ET**, London — earliest lock) | 8.04 | 8.04 | 100% | Healthy |

**Total expected: 143.72.** Above the typical 100-140 band, same as last week (145.18) — a genuinely strong, mostly-healthy roster, not a broken number. *JSN's row is the pre-game projection, kept for table consistency; his game is already final — see Changes.

Bench, in order: Shough (QB, not needed), TreVeyon Henderson (RB, Questionable/ankle, 5.57 expected — below both FLEX starters), nobody else healthy enough to matter.

## Changes since Wednesday (2026-10-14)

No lineup slots moved — the Wednesday lineup holds. Two things resolved:

- **Jaxon Smith-Njigba's game is done.** He played through the ankle/Questionable tag Thursday night and went 12/16 for 134 yards (no TD) — **25.4 actual points**, well above his 18.65 pre-game projection. Nothing left to decide for that slot.
- **Jalen Coker is cleared.** Wednesday's briefing flagged his "Out" tag as internally inconsistent with the fixture's own 81.5% play probability and started him as "last body standing." As of Friday's report Carolina has pulled him off the injury list entirely (no report_status, Full Participation) — he's a confirmed, legitimate start now, not a hope. Expected points moves 9.39 → 11.13.
- TreVeyon Henderson moved Out (3.3%) → Questionable/ankle, Limited practice (69.4%) on the live overlay. Still ranks well behind both Skattebo and Coker — stays on the bench, but worth knowing he's no longer a zero if a Sunday-morning scratch forces a FLEX swap.

## Watch list

- **Week 8 Giants bye cluster — still unaddressed, now two weeks out.** Dominic Zvada, Cam Skattebo and Isaiah Likely (all NYG) plus bench QB Tyler Shough (NO, same week) all bye in Week 8, on top of Jaxson Dart already on IR. That's three current starters and a bench piece gone the same week, with only 5 bench spots total. The Week 7 waiver window (claims clear before Wed 10/21) is the move to make this count — don't let it slide again.
- **TreVeyon Henderson** — Questionable, ankle, Limited Friday practice. Immaterial to this week's lineup but check Sunday's inactive list (~11:30am ET) if either FLEX starter is scratched late.
- **Jaguars D/ST locks first** — 9:30am ET Sunday (London). Set the lineup before then; nothing else locks until 1:00pm ET.

## Opponent notes

- **Jaguars D/ST vs HOU:** Houston is missing RB David Montgomery (groin, Out), WR Tank Dell (knee, Out) and S Jalen Pitre (shoulder, Out) — a significantly weakened Texans offense. Reinforces the Jaguars as the clear DEF start.
- **Skattebo/Likely/Zvada vs NO:** New Orleans is down both starting linebackers (Kaden Elliss, Anfernee Jennings — both Out). A thinner Saints front is a mild tailwind for Skattebo's volume.
- **Coker @ PHI:** Philadelphia is without Jalen Hurts (calf, Out) and Saquon Barkley (hamstring, Out) — a backup-QB Eagles offense. Likely means more defensive-side opportunity against Carolina's offense is secondary to this; worth noting PHI may be playing from behind, which can extend Carolina's passing volume. Monitor, don't overweight.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 7:** Jaguars D/ST (JAX) — the DEF slot needs a one-week fill or a stream.
- **Week 8:** Dominic Zvada, Cam Skattebo, Isaiah Likely (all NYG) + bench Tyler Shough (NO) — see Watch list above. This is the bigger problem.
